summary: Verified 3-axis (Payment / Fulfillment / Order) admin order lifecycle across all 7 QA-FUL seeded orders via pytest (12/12 pass) and Playwright UI (all state transitions + testids confirmed). Critical rule 'digital delivery alone must NOT close a mixed order' is enforced.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrders.js is a large single component - could be split for maintainability, but functionality is correct.
GET /api/admin/orders returns key 'items' (not 'orders'); ensure future tests use response['items'].
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed script /app/backend/scripts/seed_qa_orders.py — reset before & after backend suite via module autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_lifecycle_admin.py auto-resets QA-FUL orders via the seed script. Admin list endpoint returns paginated dict with 'items' key. Three-axis rendering testids: lifecycle-axes-<order_number>. Panel testids: manual-panel-<o>, recipient-panel-<o>, fulfillment-panel-<o>. Action testids: mark-packed-<o>, mark-shipped-<o>, mark-delivered-<o>, mark-fulfilled-<o>, reopen-manual-<o>, confirm-recipient-<o>. Buyer/recipient display testids: purchased-by-<o>, granted-to-<o>.

verified_transitions.QA-FUL-DIGITAL: already complete (digital delivered, no other lane)
verified_transitions.QA-FUL-MIXED: physical packed→shipped→delivered while manual pending stays OPEN; then manual fulfilled → COMPLETE (proves digital alone never auto-closes)
verified_transitions.QA-FUL-GIFT: recipient confirm → complete; buyer/recipient distinct emails displayed
verified_transitions.QA-FUL-IE: manual fulfilled → complete; reopen-manual button present
verified_transitions.QA-FUL-SGB: manual fulfilled → complete; reopen → open (backend test)
